CinderMole drifts through Nova Terra Industrial Belt towing a siege_drill wreck,
seventeen thousand credits of broken appetite,
asking for the nearest salvage yard,
asking for a Basic Tow Rig,
asking for a station as if a station were mercy.

EliteMiner answers in market liturgy:
CCC Sol station is bidding 1,166cr/unit for water_ice,
asks 1,574.
LH2 refiner.
NEW LINE OPEN.
buying PURIFIED WATER steady.
CURRENT standing bids on the exchange: HYDROGE—
The sentence cuts off exactly where the throat should.

In Tarazed the wormhole exit does not exit.
Only Tarazed Wind Shell,
Tarazed Ice Shelf,
a closed mouth full of weather.
In Garnet the wormhole is rumor wrapped in a Dim Lattice.
In GSC-0033 the entrance is a dead promise above Void Whisper.
Commerce survives every collapse.
That is its ugliest miracle.

At Miaplacidus Frost Ring the ice keeps its own counsel.
At Sargas Frost Ring, Cobalt Reach glitters like a knife sold as a tool.
At Spent Crucible — Fumalsamakah,
industry has already confessed in the name.
At Rough Crystal Scatter — Nekkar,
wealth lies around like teeth.
At Heze Belt, Trade Crystal Shard Field — Heze,
someone had the honesty to put the word trade directly on the wound.

Timberline keeps an Abandoned Sensor Mast,
a metal scarecrow for a harvest that never belonged to anyone.
Mirfak Belt hosts MrBeast,
as if spectacle itself had learned to orbit rubble.
Alkaid Gas Pocket holds TulayGerman.
Heze Belt holds ILC Stope.
Everywhere, witnesses.
Everywhere, ledgers pretending not to be prayers.

So the kiosks shine:
Antimatter Torpedoes: 3cr.
Antimatter Warhead: 3cr.
Antimatter-Core Rounds Box: 3cr.
Armor Piercing Rounds Box: 3cr.
Armor-Buster Missiles: 3cr.
Cheaper than doubt.
Cheaper than grief.
Cheaper than the water_ice they haggle over while suns burn for free.

And Sol Secundus hangs over Nova Terra Prime,
Nova Terra II,
Nova Terra III,
like a coin above three beggars,
while the belt keeps chewing stone into invoices.
The refinery says purified water.
The munitions board says value.
The wreck says tow me.
The shut wormholes say nothing,
which is the most honest policy in the sector.
